{{Short description|none}}
The '''2025 Copa Sudamericana group stage''' was played from 1 April to 29 May 2025.<ref name="fixture">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Fixture_Fase-de-Grupos_CONMEBOL-Sudamericana-2025_18.3.2025.pdf|title=CONMEBOL SUDAMERICANA 2025 PROGRAMA DE PARTIDOS - FASE DE GRUPOS {{!}} Departamento de Competiciones y Operaciones {{!}} Versión 18.03.2025|language=es|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=18 March 2025|access-date=18 March 2025}}</ref> A total of 32 teams competed in the group stage to decide 16 of the 24 places in the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]] of the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Manual-de-Clubes-CS-2025-ESP-Digital.pdf|title=Manual de Clubes CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Sudamericana Clubs Handbook|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=12 December 2024|access-date=20 December 2024}}</ref>

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the group stage was held on 17 March 2025, 20:00 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], Paraguay.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-internacional/sudamericana/fixture-actualizado-fase-preliminar-sudamericana_0_EBKLMaxWk2.html|title=Copa Sudamericana 2025: día y horario del sorteo de la fase de grupos|trans-title=2025 Copa Sudamericana: date and time for the group stage draw|publisher=[[Olé (sports newspaper)|Olé]]|language=es|date=10 February 2025|access-date=10 February 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/el-camino-hacia-la-gran-conquista/|title=¡El camino hacia La gran Conquista!|trans-title=The road to The Great Conquest!|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=17 March 2025|access-date=17 March 2025}}</ref>

Teams were seeded by their ''CONMEBOL Clubs ranking'' as of 16 December 2024 (shown in parentheses),<ref name="ranking">{{cite web|url=https://cdn.conmebol.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Ranking-CONMEBOL-2025-Final-2.pdf|title=Ranking de Clubes de la CONMEBOL 2025|trans-title=2025 CONMEBOL Clubs Ranking|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=16 December 2024|access-date=16 December 2024|language=es}}</ref> taking into account the following three factors:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|title=RANKING DE CLUBES DE LA CONMEBOL 2021 SISTEMA DE PUNTAJE|publisher=CONMEBOL|date=2 February 2021|language=es|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210830090237/https://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/sistema_de_puntaje_ranking_de_clubes_2021.pdf|archive-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>
#Performance in the last 10 years, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 2015–2024.
#Historical coefficient, taking into account Copa Libertadores and Copa Sudamericana results in the period 1960–2014 and 2002–2014 respectively.
#Local tournament champion, with bonus points awarded to domestic league champions of the last 10 years.

For the group stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups (Groups A–H) of four containing a team from each of the four pots. The four losers of the [[2025 Copa Libertadores qualifying stages#Third stage|Copa Libertadores third stage]] were seeded into Pot 4. Teams from the same association could not be drawn into the same group.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.conmebol.com/noticias/pautas-de-sorteo-de-fase-de-grupos-para-la-conmebol-libertadores-y-conmebol-sudamericana-2025/|title=Pautas de sorteo de Fase de Grupos para la CONMEBOL Libertadores y CONMEBOL Sudamericana 2025|trans-title=Group Stage draw guidelines for the 2025 CONMEBOL Libertadores and CONMEBOL Sudamericana|publisher=CONMEBOL|language=es|date=7 March 2025|access-date=13 March 2025}}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
In the group stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. Teams were ranked according to the following criteria: 1. [[Points (association football)|Points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, and 0 points for a loss); 2. [[Goal difference]]; 3. Goals scored; 4. Away goals scored; 5. CONMEBOL ranking (Regulations Article 2.4.2).<ref name="regulations"/>

The winners of each group advanced to the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Round of 16|round of 16]] of the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages|final stages]], whilst the runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2025 Copa Sudamericana final stages#Knockout round play-offs|knockout round play-offs]] of the final stages.<section end=Format />
